title: Can an LLM dream? Testing the overfitted brain hypothesis on an agent with text memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.21648v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hoel (2021) proposed that dreams distort replayed experience so that the brain does not overfit to recent events. We test this hypothesis on an LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5) that stores what it learns in a text memory and rewrites that memory each night from the day's conversation transcript. The agent goes through ten simulated days of conversation built from LongMemEval. We corrupt 5, 10, 20 or 40 percent of the transcript's turns before each nightly rewrite in one of two ways. Detail corruption changes one or two details in a turn to plausible wrong ones, or replaces the turn with one by the same speaker from an earlier day. Random-text corruption replaces half of the selected turns with a passage of Moby-Dick and inserts Moby-Dick words into the other half. A size limit on the memory, rising from 19,500 to 117,000 tokens over ten nights, set from human free-recall data, forces it to forget. We learned that corruption did not help the

translated_title: LLM会做梦吗？在具有文本记忆的智能体上测试“过拟合大脑”假说
translated_abstract: Hoel（2021）提出，梦境会对重放的经验进行扭曲，从而防止大脑对近期事件产生过拟合。我们在一个LLM智能体（Claude Opus 5.5）上测试了这一假说，该智能体将所学内容存储在文本记忆中，并在每晚根据当天的对话记录重写这份记忆。该智能体经历了由LongMemEval构建的十个模拟天的对话。我们在每晚记忆重写之前，以两种方式之一损坏对话记录中5%、10%、20%或40%的轮次：细节损坏方式将某一轮中的一两个细节改为看似合理的错误内容，或用同一说话者在更早一天的某轮对话替换该轮；随机文本损坏方式用《白鲸记》中的一段文字替换一半被选中的轮次，并在另一半轮次中插入《白鲸记》的词汇。记忆大小限制在十晚内从19,500个token逐步提升至117,000个token（该上限基于人类自由回忆数据设定），迫使智能体遗忘。我们发现，损坏并未对该智能体起到帮助作用……
tldr: 该研究将“做梦防止大脑过拟合”假说应用于具有文本记忆的LLM智能体，通过在每晚记忆重写前对当天对话记录施加细节损坏或随机文本损坏来模拟梦境扭曲，结果显示这种损坏并未带来帮助。
en_tdlr: This study tests Hoel's overfitted brain hypothesis—the idea that dreams distort replayed experience to prevent overfitting—on an LLM agent with a text memory that rewrites itself nightly, by corrupting daily conversation transcripts in two ways, and finds that such corruption did not help.
